text_block_list.text: While organizing paperwork— I got a call from Mayano Top Gun's homeroom teacher saying she skipped class without permission...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, a vapor trail...
I wonder if riding on it would be thrilling...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Maya doesn't wanna go to class.
'Cause it's boring!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Racing, shopping, chatting...
Maya used to love it all... but now everything's boring.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: My body keeps getting heavier... and heavier, like a sack of bricks...

With so many consecutive races recently, she must be feeling the fatigue.
It seems necessary to reconsider our race schedule...
